=== maintenance down  ·  no arguments
$ orion-node maintenance down

 ◆ Maintenance
 ╭ Why? ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │ ┃ › kernel upgrade                                                                 │
 │ Optional. Shown on the incident and in status.                                     │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 ╭ How long? ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  2 hours   1 hour  4 hours  24 hours  custom…                                      │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

    Start     Cancel

 ╭ Result ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │ ✓ Maintenance on               alerts muted until 16:42                            │
 │ ✓ Core told                                                                        │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Short form:  orion-node maintenance down "kernel upgrade" --for 2h

=== maintenance down  ·  edge cases
$ orion-node maintenance down "disk swap"

   ✓ Maintenance on               until 14:32 tomorrow
   ! Local only
     │ This host is not enrolled, so Core was not told.
     │ Connect it first:  orion-node setup

$ orion-node maintenance down --for 800h

 ERROR  Maintenance can last at most 720 h
   Try --for 720h, or end it early with orion-node maintenance up

=== maintenance up, and how status shows it
$ orion-node maintenance up

   ✓ Maintenance off              alerts resume
   ✓ Core told

$ orion-node status

 ◆ edge-05                                                              ‖ Maintenance
   kernel upgrade · alerts muted until 16:42 (1 h 52 m)
   ▸ orion-node maintenance up  end it early

--- notes
NOTE Always ends: Default 24 h, never more than 720 h, so it cannot be forgotten. status shows when it ends.
NOTE A form only when you give nothing: With no arguments on a terminal a short Huh form asks why and for how long. With arguments it just runs, so scripts are unchanged.
NOTE Honest about Core: If Core could not be told, the line says Local only and what to do. Nothing silently half-works.
NOTE Same words everywhere: The chip in status and the log viewer header use the same MAINTENANCE state.
